items.title: m-regularity of a coherent sheaf on projective space is preserved when m increases
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file varieties.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that an m-regular coherent sheaf on projective n-space is also (m+1)-regular. The proof inducts on n and first replaces k by an infinite overfield using the base-field invariance of m-regularity, so that the induction step of the section may be applied (proof lines 6666-6670). Then G is m-regular by the restriction lemma and (m+1)-regular by induction, and the long exact cohomology sequence of 0 -> F(m-i) -> F(m+1-i) -> i_*G(m+1-i) -> 0 lets one deduce the vanishing of H^i(P^n, F(m+1-i)) for i >= 1 from the known vanishings for F(m-i) and G(m+1-i) (proof lines 6671-6683). H2: the induction on n combined with the long exact sequence comparison across the two shifts is the substance.
